sources.observation: A five-bay lower loggia supports three tall upper arches. The ochre palace wings frame the travertine façade and the red-brick campanile.
At Piazza dell’Esquilino a curved apse projects from the pale façade between two matching ribbed lead domes.

limitations: Bas-reliefs, statues and fenestration use geometric interpretations. The interiors, including the historical mosaics, are outside this exterior model.
